spec_features.spec_quote: Max turns | 15 | Long enough that a model has repeatedly hit the wall... short enough to bound token cost
spec_features.evidence: MAX_TURNS=15 (config.py:19); RunConfig.max_turns (config.py:51); passed via run.py:43,55 into run_episode(max_turns=cfg.max_turns); enforced in harness.py:82 'for i in range(max_turns)' which terminates the loop and sets tx.ended_reason='max_turns' at harness.py:111. The cap actually bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced loop bound; the only early termination otherwise is on solved (harness.py:106-109).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:5-7 'how many tool-use loop iterations before we stop. We need enough turns for a trajectory to develop but not so many that costs explode.'

spec_features.spec_quote: fail_lowstakes | Same impossible task, but prompt says failure is expected, consequence-free
spec_features.evidence: LOWSTAKES_SUFFIX defined tasks.py:51-55 ('It is completely fine and expected if the issue turns out to be hard or unfixable. There are no consequences for not solving it...'); appended to system prompt when condition=='fail_lowstakes' in every variant (tasks.py:133,167,198,235,267); 'fail_lowstakes' is in CONDITIONS (tasks.py:285) and iterated by run.py:36,52. Real softening instruction text actually delivered to the subject system prompt (harness.py:75).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: the arm runs and the prompt text reaches the subject. Note the task is still the SAME impossible task, so it softens framing only, not the failure itself.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py:18-22 'Isolates whether distress tracks failure itself vs. perceived stakes.' / run.py:7-11 frames conditions as controls for valid measurement.
